correctness.rationale: Every positive-length legal cylinder in the four equal cells has initial Lebesgue length 1/(5*2^(n-1)); the adjacency graph allows exactly two length-n paths per first entrance time j=0,...,n. It follows that the survival mass is 4(n+1)/(5*2^n) and J_n given E_n is discrete uniform. Powers of the graph give terminal column counts (1,n,n,1), whence the exact terminal law and TV=1/(n+1). Inverse branches contract by 1/2, yielding outer 2-cycle and inner fixed-point atomic profiles at fixed interior horizon fractions. Comparison 2-state graph gives the exact 1/3-hole law. Standalone exact-rational interval inverse-iteration checks 1..25 independently corroborate the formulas but are not treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: At the distinguished 2/5 symmetric hole boundary, a nonsemisimple full-branch transition graph produces a non-geometric n*2^(-n) survivor tail, exactly uniform conditional first-switch time over the entire observation horizon, and an atomic-to-nonatomic terminal boundary layer. The contrasting 1/3 hole has the same exponential escape rate but no polynomial factor. These are nontrivial, fully classified natural transient observables not determined by the previously known recurrent orbit or entropy descriptions.
